title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 13:00 UTC on 22 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 22 日 13:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.00 (0Z) at 13:00 UTC. The 13:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 13:59; hour-end 0.33/0P). The trailing 14:00 hour is incomplete (49 samples through 14:48) and is not used as the headline hour. Last-180 maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-22 14:46 UTC; label 1M; last-180 window from 11:49 UTC). Published-window maximum is 0.67 (first at 2026-09-22 14:46 UTC; label 1M). Window start 2026-09-22 08:51 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最後可靠整點估計 Kp 為 0.00（0Z），取樣 13:00 UTC。13:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 13:59，時段末 0.33／0P）。14:00 時段尚未收滿（49 筆至 14:48），不作為主卡片整點。近 180 筆最大 0.67（最先見於 2026-09-22 14:46 UTC；標籤 1M；近 180 筆窗自 11:49 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 0.67（最先見於 14:46 UTC；標籤 1M）。窗起點 2026-09-22 08:51 UTC（358 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (13:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 13:00 UTC is 0.00/0Z; the hour ends 0.33/0P at 13:59. The incomplete 14:00 hour is excluded from the headline.

title.en: A magnitude 4.7 earthquake occurred 7 km WNW of La Gomera, Guatemala on 22 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 22 日，瓜地馬拉 La Gomera 西北西約 7 公里發生規模 4.7 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.7, depth about 89 km. Current day-feed maximum is mb 5.3 (us7000tj1s, 97 km S of Sarangani, Philippines).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 4.7，深度約 89 公里。一日饋送目前最大為 mb 5.3（us7000tj1s，菲律賓 Sarangani 以南約 97 公里）。

data.place: 7 km WNW of La Gomera, Guatemala

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
